column1: # e2e-budgets.tsv — per-spec-file time budgets for the OFFLINE e2e lane (advisory).
# Format: <spec file> TAB <seconds> [TAB # note]. `#` starts a comment line. The seconds are a file's
# summed test durations (scripts/e2e-budgets.mjs), not wall clock.
# EVIDENCE: each budget is about TWICE the time measured on 2026-10-13 in a Linux cloud
# container (3 workers, a green 30-test run, 4.7 min wall), rounded up, with a 30 s floor so
# a few-second file is not flagged on noise. The measured seconds are in the comments.
# Re-measure and update a row when a spec legitimately grows; never just raise it to quiet
# a warning without finding out why the file slowed down.
